description: Read-only status of the point-in-time Longbridge archive (#2575). The capture runs outside Neige as a systemd timer; this plugin only reads the archive and the capture's last exit, never the token, and never calls Longbridge.
planner_instructions: research-archive reports the health of the Longbridge archive capture, a systemd timer outside Neige; nothing here captures or changes the archive. plugin_research_archive_status answers ok, attention or failing, with every reason and the recent runs. failing means a person has to act on the host (a lost day stays failing until a later day ends complete): ask the owner with neige_user_ask, one question quoting the reasons, and ask again only when the reasons change. attention means data was lost or is weaker than planned: say so in the Report, without asking. plugin_research_archive_watch with on: true keeps this Track's live archive.status table, which the Report shows with a table block whose source is neige://plugin/research-archive/archive.status; on: false removes it.

exposes_tools.name: status
exposes_tools.description: The archive's health now: ok, attention or failing, every reason, how the last capture start ended, and the last 7 runs with their pair counts (ok, tried with no ok, not tried, planned) and index membership. failing: a recent run ended partial or degraded (fewer than half its pairs ok) and no later day has ended complete since, missed days included; the last start had no usable token or stopped on a fatal error; no start has recorded its exit for longer than the configured bound; or the archive cannot be read. attention: a partial or degraded run that a later complete day followed, a recent day was missed, a run ended complete with pairs that have no ok, the latest universe is not observed, or the missed-day scan was incomplete. Reads local files only.

exposes_tools.name: watch
exposes_tools.description: Start (on: true) or stop (on: false) keeping the live archive.status table on the calling Track. The table refreshes on the plugin's own poll, only when the status changes; stopping deletes it from this Track.

on.description: true to show the table on this Track, false to remove it

data_dir.description: Absolute path of the capture job's data dir (its config's data_dir). The plugin reads archive.sqlite3 read-only and last_exit.json there, and nothing else.

poll_seconds.description: Seconds between status reads for watching Tracks (10 to 3600).

stale_after_minutes.description: Minutes after the last recorded capture exit at which the status says the timer is not starting the capture (60 to 2880). It must exceed 30 (the timer's interval) plus the capture's attempt_timeout_minutes, with a margin: a start can hold the lock that long, and a start that finds the lock held records nothing. The default 90 fits attempt_timeout_minutes up to about 45.
